author: Vivian Chow
title: In‑N‑Out Burger to open new location in Orange County - NewsBreak
text:
By Vivian Chow No media credit provided. ,
1 hours ago
As In‑N‑Out Burger announced new locations set to open across several states this year, one of the newest locations in its home state of Southern California will open in Irvine.
The restaurant will be a part of The Canopy, a sprawling 12-acre retail center still in development at the Great Park Neighborhoods.
Among the many new shops and restaurants claiming a spot is an In-N-Out location at 7900 Great Park Blvd.
The restaurant will be 3,808 square feet and will offer a drive-thru service, according to The Canopy’s website. The location is slated to open in late 2026.
In February 2025, In-N-Out CEO Lynsi Snyder announced that In‑N‑Out’s corporate office in Irvine will close by 2030, with all operations shifting back to the company’s roots at a home office in Baldwin Park, where her grandparents founded the chain in 1948.
In 2023, the burger chain also announced an expansion into Tennessee. The majority of In-N-Out’s corporate staff will now either work at the new Baldwin Park office or in Franklin, Tennessee, where a new “Eastern territory” office is set to open in late 2026, the company said.
Alongside the new Irvine location, in 2026, the chain also announced upcoming locations in Oregon, Nevada, Tennessee, Utah and Colorado.
As of May 2026, In-N-Out has more than 400 restaurants in California, Arizona, Nevada, Colorado, Oregon, Utah, Idaho, New Mexico, Texas, Tennessee and Washington.
